headline: フルオロプロリンの立体が、NCBDの結合力を左右する
subhead: 既存のNMR構造2KKJなどと比べ、19F NMRでヘリックスの向きを調べた

summary.question: モルテングロビュール（折りたたみが緩く揺らぐ状態）のNCBDは、構造の詳細を調べにくい。
summary.approach: ループの2か所のプロリンを、立体が逆の4-フルオロプロリン（4R・4S）に置き換え、19F NMRなどで調べた。
summary.result: NOEによる構造計算で3本のヘリックスの向きが変種ごとに異なり、AD-ACTRとの結合力も変わった。
summary.learned: 炭素4位の立体の反転だけで、ヘリックスの向きと結合力が変わった。プロリンは離れた部位の動きの連動を調節しうる。
summary.open: 構造計算は単一の立体配座を仮定しており、各変種が取る構造の広がりを定量的には表せない。

question.quote: However, due to multiple conformations existing in dynamic equilibrium on a wide range of timescales, the detailed structural characterization of molten‐globules remains challenging.

approach.quote: To assess the specific role of prolines in the conformational dynamics of the NCBD, we used a chemical biology approach combining NMR with the site‐specific incorporation of stereoisomeric 4‐(R)‐ and 4‐(S)‐fluoroprolines within both loops of NCBD (Figure 1A).

result.quote: The resulting sets of structures display different orientations of the three helices depending on the fluorination site and fluoroproline stereochemistry (Figures 3 and S22).
Among the four fluorinated variants of NCBD, P13(4R) and P30(4R) variants are slightly better binders than WT NCBD

learned.quote: Seemingly subtle inversion of chirality at carbon‐4 atom was sufficient to modify the relative orientation of α‐helices and to modulate the binding affinity of the resulting NCBD variants to AD‐ACTR.
Our results explicitly show how prolines can modulate dynamics and long‐range couplings between protein structural elements

open.quote: While the modelling procedure used in this work does not provide a quantitative model of the conformational space sampled by each variants due to the presence of minor conformational states and their effect on NOE values
It should be stressed that the use of a single conformer during the modelling is biasing the set of representative conformations.

highlights.text: 立体が逆のフルオロプロリンで、3本のヘリックスの向きが変わった。4R体のP13だけが、既存の2KKJ（単独）と1KBH（AD-ACTRとの複合体）に近い向きで、他の3変種は別の角度の組み合わせをとった。

evidence.quote: Out of the four fluorinated NCBDs, only P13(4R) displayed relative helices orientation comparable to a previously reported solution structure of free NCBD [17] (PDB ID: 2KKJ) and in complex with AD‐ACTR (PDB: ID 1KBH) [28].
The three other variants sample helical orientations resulting from different combinations of previously observed α1/α2 and α2/α3 interhelical angles.

highlights.text: ITCでは、P13の4R体の方が4S体より強く結合した（KDは277 nMと402 nM）。フッ素は結合界面になくても、19F NMRの信号は結合の有無を反映した。著者はこれを、複合体に近い形に偏った状態が選ばれる機構と考える。

evidence.quote: Our results are consistent with these data with KD of 277 nM for P13(4R) NCBD and 402 nM for P13(4S) NCBD variants at 25 °C, respectively.
Remarkably, all four fluorine spectra reported on the binding event, despite the fact that the corresponding prolines are not directly located at the protein–protein interface.
suggesting a conformational selection mechanism involving an allosteric coupling between the loop L1 and the remaining parts of the protein

highlights.text: P30の4R体だけが、中性のpHでアミロイドを作った。この変種のモデルでは第1ヘリックスの向きが他と180°違い、著者は、凝集しやすい部位が溶媒に出る可能性を挙げている。

evidence.quote: Strikingly, for only one variant with 4‐(R)‐Pro at position 30 we observed the self‐assembly into amyloids at neutral pH

The representative conformations of NCBD P30(4R) variant obtained with the help of ARIA software indicate a particular orientation of the first helix that is rotated by 180° compared to other fluorinated NCBDs.
This local effect may lead to a transient reorientation of NCBD helices exposing ‘aggregation hotspots’ localized in helices α2 and α3

lab_notes.expression: 発現ではなく、固相ペプチド合成で作成した。
lab_notes.construct: CBPの2066〜2112（47残基）。2077位（P13）か2094位（P30）をフルオロプロリンに置換。
lab_notes.purification: HPLCで精製し、20 mMリン酸緩衝液 pH 7.2に溶かした。
lab_notes.data_collection: 1H-1H NOESYを304 K、700・900 MHzで測定し、ARIAで構造計算。19F NMRは565 MHz。

evidence.quote: Four 47‐residues NCBD variants (encompassing residues 2066 to 2112 of CBP) were synthesized using solid‐phase peptide synthesis by inserting either a 4‐(R)‐FPro or a 4‐(S)‐FPro at positions 2077 or 2094
The resulting proteins were purified using HPLC (Figures S1–S4) and dissolved in a 20 mM phosphate buffer at pH 7.2.
The 3D structures of the four modified NCBDs were investigated using 1H‐1H NOESY spectra recorded at 304 K and at proton frequencies of 700 and 900 MHz.
565 MHz 19F NMR spectra of the four modified NCBD variants dissolved in H2O/D2O

keywords: モルテングロビュール
editor_notes: 新しい構造ではない（impact: mechanism）。既存のNMR構造2KKJ・1KBHは、変種のモデルとの比較に使われている。変種のNOE構造モデルは本文ではPDBへの登録に触れておらず、データはZenodoで公開とだけ書かれている。著者自身が単一の立体配座を仮定したモデルは偏るとしている。本文にMethods節はなく（補足資料）、lab_notesは本文中の記述のみ。構造図は2KKJ（遊離型NCBD）。1KBHはAD-ACTRとの複合体。
